proves.claim: clause 1: a hold whose reason starts with "Coordinator hold:" and names only landed items stays on through main-moved, merged and withdraw events.

store.logic-board-holds-settled.review-h.why: A coordinator review hold lifted by the settled-hold rule let the lander merge an item with a clause unproven.

proves.claim: clause 2: a parent held with the "Coordinator hold:" prefix stays held when all its children are done.

store.logic-board-holds-settled.review-p.why: The parent-children settle rule must not lift a coordinator review hold.

proves.claim: clause 3: a hold without the "Coordinator hold:" prefix still lifts when its named items or children are done.

store.logic-board-holds-settled.plain-ho.why: The exclusion must stay narrow so ordinary holds keep settling.
